title: A literature review on automated machine learning
core_idea: Provide a comprehensive survey of AutoML research tracing its evolution from early metalearning, hyperparameter optimization, and transfer learning to recent advances in neural architecture search, automated pipeline design, and few-shot learning; cover historical context, classical approaches, modern applications, and emerging topics while highlighting research directions such as interpretability, generalization and robustness, expanded pipeline automation, and ethical implications.
tldr: A concise, holistic survey of AutoML methods and evolution that summarizes key approaches and emerging research directions to guide researchers and practitioners.
